card.name: Small words before a following noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "or", "on" and "have" right before a noun phrase that is about to be named. They appear in explanatory or definitional text, and the next word is usually a thing or an amount.

modes.label: "of" after a noun
modes.description: The word "of" comes after a quantity or a defining noun, just before the thing being named.
modes.example: add 9.3 mL<< of>> Busulfan Injection to 93

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like "or", "on" or "have" sit before a noun phrase in explanatory prose.
modes.example: whichever player<< or>> players find themselves nearest the goal.

modes.label: Opening quote after answered
modes.description: An opening quotation mark follows a verb of answering, just before the quoted reply.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words that mean "the said" (該, 该, 这名) and to favor plural group words, so it pushes against pointing back to a noun already mentioned.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a new thing is named, in definitions and explanations.
